data.title: As a stack consumer, detect-strata.sh is wired into A0 detector orchestration and documented as a sibling-detector example

content.text: **What**: Wire detect-strata.sh output into A0's detector-orchestration so its tags union into the unified stack array (NOT a separate config key). Document detect-strata.sh in A0's DETECTION-SCHEMA.md as a worked example of \"adding a sibling detector\".
**Why**: A0 owns the unified array contract; A2 contributes via the published sibling-detector pattern.
- IN: Wiring in A0's orchestration entrypoint; DETECTION-SCHEMA.md worked-example section update; behavior preserved on non-Strata projects (zero new keys).
- OUT: Modifying A0's schema beyond the worked example.
- When complete, detect-strata.sh tags appear in the unified stack array on Strata projects ← Satisfies: SC1, SC4
- When complete, no new top-level config key is introduced ← Satisfies: SC1
- When complete, DETECTION-SCHEMA.md contains the worked example referencing detect-strata.sh ← Satisfies: SC4
- When complete, unit tests written and passing for the orchestration union

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
